C).text:
The default BPM is 120.
If you want to change it, replace the number in the middle with the BPM of your project.

^G@|qbm;FUv3D3N(kxAY.text:
The leftmost space is how many measures long a loop is. Basically all Incredibox mods have 4-measure-long loops, but if you want to change that for some reason, you can.

The second space is your mod's BPM, which defaults to 120.

The third and fourth spaces are your mod's time signature, which determines how many of a note are in one measure. This defaults to 4/4 time, which I recommend you leave like that unless you understand music theory.
